name: aqmen
description: The Aqmen connector plus thin skills for Claude. The method lives on the Aqmen platform — any connected agent reads it with read_instructions; the skills add what only Claude does: the six jobs (market sizing, company analysis, competitive landscape, due diligence, proposal, refresh) chaining the six practices (scope, research, model, challenge, conclude, deliver) stage by stage, parallel researchers and fresh-context critics. Everything is made in Aqmen. Each job is a project in the client's workspace, ending in findings approved claim by claim and a deck whose every figure is sourced.
